title: Question 1
question: What does the poem “A Letter to God” show about Lencho’s faith?
answer: It shows his deep and unquestioning faith in God.

title: Question 2
question: Why did Lencho call the post office employees a bunch of crooks?
answer: He believed they had taken part of the money sent by God.

title: Question 3
question: What was the young seagull afraid of in “His First Flight”?
answer: He was afraid that his wings would not support him and he would fall.

title: Question 4
question: How did the young seagull finally make his first flight?
answer: Hunger and his mother’s tempting food made him dive; he spread his wings and flew.

title: Question 5
question: Why was Anne Frank’s diary important to her?
answer: She treated it as a trusted friend with whom she could share her thoughts.

title: Question 6
question: What does Nelson Mandela say courage is?
answer: Courage is not the absence of fear but the triumph over it.

title: Question 7
question: What are the two obligations mentioned by Mandela?
answer: Obligations to family and to one’s people and country.

title: Question 8
question: Why was the baker important in Goan village life in “A Baker from Goa”?
answer: Bread was an essential part of daily life and celebrations.

title: Question 9
question: What is the central idea of “Dust of Snow”?
answer: A small natural incident can change a person’s mood for the better.

title: Question 10
question: What do the tiger and the cage symbolize in “A Tiger in the Zoo”?
answer: The tiger symbolizes wild freedom; the cage represents captivity.

title: Question 11
question: Why did Valli want to ride the bus?
answer: She was curious and wanted to experience a bus journey.

title: Question 12
question: What lesson does “The Sermon at Benares” teach?
answer: Death is universal; wisdom comes from accepting this truth.

title: Question 13
question: Why did Kisa Gotami go to the Buddha?
answer: She wanted a medicine to bring her dead son back to life.

title: Question 14
question: What made the young lawyer in “The Hack Driver” trust Oliver Lutkins?
answer: Lutkins appeared friendly and helpful, though he was actually deceiving him.

title: Question 15
question: Why did Bholi refuse to marry Bishamber?
answer: She refused to marry a greedy man who demanded dowry and insulted her family.

title: Question 16
question: How did education change Bholi’s life?
answer: It gave her confidence, self-respect and the courage to speak up.

title: Question 17
question: What is the message of “The Proposal” by Anton Chekhov?
answer: It humorously exposes pride, greed and quarrels over trivial matters.

title: Question 18
question: What does the poem “Fire and Ice” suggest?
answer: Desire and hatred can both cause destruction.

title: Question 19
question: Why is the poem “Amanda!” written as a series of instructions?
answer: It shows the constant restrictions placed on Amanda and her desire for freedom.

title: Question 20
question: What is the central idea of “The Trees”?
answer: Nature seeks freedom from confinement and returns to its natural place.
